name: First team value within 30 days
definition: Cohort accounts that meet the threshold within 30 days of signature / all cohort accounts (cancellations stay in the denominator). Threshold: in one rolling 7-day window, 3 or more distinct users each create, approve or send an invoice and 5 or more real (non-test) invoices are sent. Reported split by external accountant vs in-house once the field exists
population: New accounts with 3+ seats, by signature-month cohort
cadence: monthly cohort, readable 30 days after the cohort month closes
target: 42% for cohorts signed Jan-Mar 2027 (n about 240; see stats.md for the detectable change)

name: Days to first synced real invoice
definition: Per account, calendar days from signature to the first non-test invoice that posts to the ledger without rejection; report median and p90; accounts with no synced invoice by day 30 reported separately as a share
source: Product events + sync log; baseline EVD-2026-0021
population: Cohort accounts that attempt a ledger sync
baseline: median 12 among 284 accounts with a synced invoice (p90 not yet cut)
target: median 9 or fewer for Q1 2027 cohorts; expected to move MET-0001 (edge inferred)

name: First-attempt sync success rate
definition: Accounts whose first sync attempt posts without a mapping or tax-rate rejection / accounts making a first sync attempt in the month
source: Connector sync error log; baseline EVD-2026-0003
population: Accounts making a first sync attempt in the month (about 64 a month)
cadence: monthly, with a rolling 8-week p-chart; act on a control-limit breach
target: 80% for the two vendors with a change feed by end of Q1 2027; expected to move MET-0002 (edge inferred)

name: Set-up session lead time
definition: Flow metric: per request, business days from request to session held, reported for requests made in the month; requests still open at month end are censored and reported as the share still waiting after 10 business days; median and p90
population: Session requests submitted through the form in the month
target: none until the edge to MET-0003 is checked

name: Teammate invite sent within 14 days
definition: Cohort accounts sending at least one teammate invite within 14 days of signature / cohort accounts
population: New accounts with 3+ seats, by signature-month cohort
baseline: not yet measured; only the 30-day rate exists (58%, EVD-2026-0008), which is not the same metric

name: Admin confidence that invoices post correctly
definition: Admins answering 4 or 5 to 'I am confident that invoices sent from Ledgerly match my books' (1-5) / admins answering; asked in product 3 days after the first synced invoice; report response rate
population: Admins of accounts with a first synced invoice

name: Admin logged in within 7 days
definition: Cohort accounts with at least one admin login within 7 days of signature / cohort accounts
population: New accounts with 3+ seats, by signature-month cohort

name: Specialist minutes on mapping per session
definition: Minutes of a set-up session spent on tax-rate and account mapping, per session; median
target: none until the edge to MET-0004 is checked

name: 90-day logo retention of new accounts
definition: Cohort accounts still paying 90 days after signature / cohort accounts
population: New accounts with 3+ seats, by signature-month cohort

name: Specialist hours per new account
definition: Specialist hours logged against onboarding cases in the month / accounts with an onboarding case opened in the month

name: Posted invoices corrected in the ledger within 60 days (confirmatory)
definition: Invoices posted from Ledgerly that are edited, reversed or re-posted in the ledger within 60 days of posting / invoices posted, per 1,000; invoices posted by accounts in their first 60 days; readable 60 days after posting
source: Connector change feed, backfilled 90 days for the two ledgers that expose one (EVD-2026-0022); built by INI-0004
population: Invoices posted by new accounts on the two ledgers with a change feed
baseline: not yet measured; backfilled baseline due 2026-12-07 from invoices posted in September 2026

name: Invoices sent without a required approval
definition: Invoices sent by a user whose role required approval, with no approval event / invoices sent, per 1,000
population: Invoices sent by new accounts in their first 60 days

name: Teammates whose permissions are reduced in week 1
definition: Teammates whose role is downgraded within 7 days of their first invoice action / teammates with a first invoice action

name: Days a mapping question waits on the accountant
definition: Per question, business days from a mapping question being referred outside the account to the answer being applied; median and p90
source: Not observable today; event trail built by INI-0001
population: Mapping questions referred outside the account

name: Posted invoices corrected in the ledger within 14 days (fast signal)
definition: Invoices posted from Ledgerly that are edited, reversed or re-posted in the ledger within 14 days of posting / invoices posted, per 1,000; the signal the stop rules watch
source: Connector change feed, backfilled 90 days (EVD-2026-0022); built by INI-0004
population: Invoices posted by new accounts on the two ledgers with a change feed
baseline: not yet measured; backfilled baseline due 2026-12-07
target: stop when the sequential boundary is crossed; switch-off within one business day
